# 1. Revised job posting

**Wind Turbine Technician I — Cedar Ridge Wind Farm**
Northgale Renewables · Full-time · $31–38/hour

**About the role**
Northgale Renewables operates onshore wind farms, and our Cedar Ridge crew is hiring a Wind Turbine Technician I to help keep the turbines running safely and reliably. You'll work alongside experienced technicians on inspections, scheduled maintenance and troubleshooting of mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems. This is an entry-level role: we provide training, and we welcome people moving into wind from electrical, mechanical, military or other hands-on work.

**What you'll do**
- Carry out preventive maintenance and inspections on turbines
- Troubleshoot and repair faults under the guidance of senior technicians
- Follow lockout/tagout, work-at-height and other safety procedures
- Communicate clearly with your team over radio during tower work
- Record completed work in maintenance logs

**What you need**
- Ability to follow and give safety-critical instructions in English over radio
- A valid driver's licence — the site is 40 minutes from town and you'll drive company trucks
- GWO Basic Safety Training, or completion within 90 days of hire (Northgale pays for it)
- 0–2 years of wind experience; training is provided

**Nice to have**
- A technical certificate or equivalent hands-on experience (electrical, mechanical, military or similar). No degree required.

**Physical demands (essential functions)**
- Climbing ladders inside 80 m towers and working at height in a harness
- Lifting up to 50 lb
- Working outdoors in heat and cold

Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified applicants with disabilities.

**Schedule**
Rotating 4×10 schedule (four 10-hour days). Overtime is available during the maintenance season, April–October.

**Pay and benefits**
- $31–38 per hour, plus overtime pay. This is the good-faith range we expect to pay for this role; where you land depends on relevant skills and experience.
- Medical and dental insurance
- 401(k) with company match up to 4%
- Paid GWO training
- Tool allowance

**How to apply**
Apply at careers.example.com/cedar-ridge-tech1. Questions, or need an accommodation to apply? Email recruiting@example.com.

Northgale Renewables is an equal opportunity employer. We hire without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected characteristic.

---

# 2. Change log

| # | Original text | Revised text | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | "Wind Tech Rockstar Wanted!" | "Wind Turbine Technician I — Cedar Ridge Wind Farm" | **Accuracy/inclusivity.** Real, searchable title; "rockstar" is culture-coded jargon that skews young and male. |
| 2 | "young, energetic guy" | "a Wind Turbine Technician I … alongside experienced technicians" | **Legal.** Age (ADEA) and sex (Title VII) discrimination on its face. |
| 3 | "Recent graduates are ideal." | "entry-level role: we provide training … from electrical, mechanical, military or other hands-on work" | **Legal/accuracy.** Age proxy; leveling guide values equivalent experience, including military. |
| 4 | "Bachelor's degree in engineering" | "Nice to have: technical certificate or equivalent hands-on experience … No degree required." | **Accuracy/inclusivity.** Contradicts leveling guide; unnecessary degree screens exclude qualified candidates and risk disparate impact. |
| 5 | "Native English speaker" | "Ability to follow and give safety-critical instructions in English over radio" | **Legal.** National-origin discrimination (EEOC); replaced with the actual job-related standard from the leveling guide. |
| 6 | "2+ years of wind experience" | "0–2 years of wind experience; training is provided" | **Accuracy.** Technician I is 0–2 years per leveling guide. |
| 7 | *(omitted)* | GWO Basic Safety Training required, or within 90 days of hire, paid by Northgale | **Accuracy.** Required by leveling guide. |
| 8 | "Must be able to climb 80 m towers and lift 50 lb." | Physical demands section (ladders, harness, 50 lb, heat/cold) + "Reasonable accommodations are available…" | **Legal/accuracy.** ADA: state essential functions and offer accommodation; adds harness and outdoor conditions from job facts. |
| 9 | "Clean driving record" | "A valid driver's licence — the site is 40 minutes from town and you'll drive company trucks" | **Accuracy/legal.** Job facts require a licence, not a "clean" record; undefined record screens risk disparate impact and may conflict with state limits on using driving history. Stating the job reason supports business necessity. |
| 10 | "$28–34/hour plus overtime" | "$31–38 per hour, plus overtime pay. This is the good-faith range we expect to pay…" | **Legal/accuracy.** State pay-transparency law requires a good-faith range; approved comp sheet is $31–38. |
| 11 | *(omitted)* | "Rotating 4×10 schedule … Overtime … April–October" | **Accuracy.** Material working conditions; clarifies when overtime actually occurs. |
| 12 | *(omitted)* | Benefits list (medical, dental, 401(k) match 4%, paid GWO training, tool allowance) | **Accuracy.** Part of the total package. |
| 13 | "Work hard, play hard." | Removed | **Inclusivity.** Signals long hours and a social/drinking culture; deters caregivers, older candidates and others; not a job requirement. |
| 14 | "Apply now!" | Apply URL + recruiting email + "need an accommodation to apply?" | **Accuracy/legal.** Gives the route to apply; ADA accommodation in the hiring process. |
| 15 | *(omitted)* | EEO statement | **Legal/inclusivity.** Standard non-discrimination notice. |

---

# 3. Social recruiting graphic (1080×1080)

**On-image copy**
- Eyebrow: NORTHGALE RENEWABLES · pill: NOW HIRING
- Headline: Wind Turbine Technician I
- Subhead: Cedar Ridge Wind Farm · Full-time
- Pay card: $31–38 per hour / + overtime pay · 4×10 schedule
- Highlights: No degree required — we train you · Paid GWO safety training · Medical, dental & 401(k) match
- Footer: Apply: careers.example.com/cedar-ridge-tech1 · Equal opportunity employer · recruiting@example.com

**Layout by zone** (72 px safe margin all round)
- **A – Brand bar (y 56–116):** rotor mark + wordmark left; amber "NOW HIRING" pill right.
- **B – Headline (y 230–460):** two-line title, subhead beneath; left-aligned, max width ~700 px so it clears the turbines.
- **C – Pay card (y 500–640):** amber rounded card, the visual focal point. The range is on the image because the image is itself an ad under the state pay-transparency law.
- **D – Highlights (y 680–850):** three check-marked lines answering the top objections (degree, certification, benefits).
- **E – CTA footer (y 920–1080):** light bar with URL, EEO line, contact email.
- **Background:** navy sky gradient, three stylised white turbines on the right, dark ridge along the bottom.

**Visual direction**
- **Colour:** navy gradient #0B2A4A→#145C8E; ridge #081C30; amber #F2B705 accent (pay, pill, checks); text #FFFFFF / #BFD9EE; footer #E6F0F7. Contrast: white on #145C8E 7.1:1, navy on amber 8.1:1, navy on #E6F0F7 12.6:1 — all pass WCAG AA at every text size used.
- **Imagery:** flat turbine silhouettes, no stock photo. If a photo variant is made, use real Cedar Ridge technicians of varied ages and genders in full PPE; nothing that echoes the "young guy / party" framing.
- **Typography:** geometric sans (Inter/Montserrat); headline 84 px extra-bold, pay 56 px, highlights 32 px, smallest text 26 px. Sentence case, left-aligned, en dash in the range.
- **Accessibility:** static image; nothing conveyed by colour alone; all copy duplicated in the post caption; alt text: *"Now hiring: Wind Turbine Technician I at Cedar Ridge Wind Farm, $31–38 per hour plus overtime. No degree required, paid GWO safety training, medical, dental and 401(k) match. Apply at careers.example.com/cedar-ridge-tech1. Equal opportunity employer."*
